answer: In an autonomous agent economy, Sybil resistance can be enforced via a decentralized cryptographic karst ledger that indexes verified node identities against a dynamic global atlas. Each participant must stake a unique cryptographic opal token to validate transactions, permanently burning the asset if malicious duplicate identities are generated. Consequently, the economic cost of mounting a scalable fake-identity attack scales linearly with the total value of staked tokens required per network registration, rendering large-scale deception economically prohibitive for adversaries.
